item.title: MiBeeNvr's Playback Timeline: No Stutter Between Segments, On-Demand Full Days
item.description: The annoying part of playback is not finding a recording — it is the hitch halfway through: one segment ends, the picture goes black, the progress bar jumps back to rebuffer, and then the next segment catches up. Fragmented recordings make it worse: a few seconds per segment, hundreds of switches in an evening, each one reloading from scratch. At high playback speeds the whole thing barely holds together as one continuous stream.
